verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents only a local dev-server preview and building static files that can be deployed to hosts like Vercel or Netlify. None of the evidence shows Docusaurus itself creating shareable per-pull-request preview deployments. Local previews are an adjacent feature, and any PR previews from hosting platforms belong to those platforms, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, every docs pull request gets a shareable preview deployment before it merges
